summary: Existing SelfContained CodeGraphAdapterTests expects a static integrity lookup to find codegraph.ps1 through PATH. The root-selected short test PATH excluded G:/packages/npm/prefix, so unchanged CodeGraphIntegrityProbe returns codegraph_unavailable/NotReady. Root independently read the probe and verified all three installed hashes match. This is an execution-environment input omission, not a Story 18.4 production or definition defect.
correction: Add only the verified existing G:/packages/npm/prefix directory to the short process-local PATH for the configured full SelfContained command. Preserve all suite guards/assertions and do not select LocalTools, install, index, or launch CodeGraph. Then run the configured Web build.

operation.cause: short PATH omitted installed static integrity lookup directory
